from pathlib import Path

P=Path('src/courses/data')

def vec(x,y,z): return {'x':x,'y':y,'z':z}
def surf(i,pos,size,mat='green',shape='box',fr=None,re=None):
 d={'id':i,'transform':{'position':vec(*pos)},'shape':shape,'size':vec(*size),'material':mat}
 if fr is not None:d['friction']=fr
 if re is not None:d['restitution']=re
 return d
def static(i,t,pos,size,re=None):
 d={'id':i,'type':t,'transform':{'position':vec(*pos)},'size':vec(*size)}
 if re is not None:d['restitution']=re
 return d
def moving(i,t,pos,size,kind,axis,speed,distance=None,phase=None):
 m={'kind':kind,'axis':vec(*axis),'speed':speed}
 if distance is not None:m['distance']=distance
 if phase is not None:m['phase']=phase
 return {'id':i,'type':t,'transform':{'position':vec(*pos)},'size':vec(*size),'motion':m}
def hazard(i,t,pos,size,pen=1): return {'id':i,'type':t,'transform':{'position':vec(*pos)},'size':vec(*size),'penaltyStrokes':pen}
def hole(i,name,par,length,surfaces=None,obstacles=None,cupx=0,cupy=.12):
 return {'id':f'hole-{i:02d}','name':name,'par':par,'spawn':vec(0,.35,0),'cup':{'position':vec(cupx,cupy,length),'radius':.32,'captureDepth':.28},'bounds':{'min':vec(-12,-5,-4),'max':vec(12,12,length+5)},'surfaces':surfaces or [surf('fairway',(0,0,length/2),(7,.3,length+2))],'obstacles':obstacles or []}

def ts(v,indent=0):
 sp='  '*indent
 if isinstance(v,str): return repr(v).replace("'",'"')
 if isinstance(v,bool): return 'true' if v else 'false'
 if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
  return str(v).lower()
 if isinstance(v,list):
  if not v:return '[]'
  return '[\n'+',\n'.join('  '*(indent+1)+ts(x,indent+1) for x in v)+'\n'+sp+']'
 if isinstance(v,dict):
  if not v:return '{}'
  return '{\n'+',\n'.join('  '*(indent+1)+k+': '+ts(x,indent+1) for k,x in v.items())+'\n'+sp+'}'
 raise TypeError(v)

def write(filename,cid,name,theme,holes):
 body="import { createCourseBuilder } from '../CourseBuilder';\nimport type { Hole } from '../types';\n\n"
 body+=f"const holes: readonly Hole[] = {ts(holes)};\n\n"
 body+=f"export const {cid.replace('-','_')} = createCourseBuilder({{\n  id: \"{cid}\",\n  name: \"{name}\",\n  themeId: \"{theme}\",\n}}).addHoles(holes).build();\n\nexport default {cid.replace('-','_')};\n"
 (P/filename).write_text(body)
